name: IRF540
description: Popular N-channel power MOSFET in TO-220, ~100V / 33A. Common in DC switching, motor drive, and class-D. Note it is a standard-threshold (not logic-level) part, so 5V/3.3V logic does not fully turn it on. Lead order G-D-S, tab is drain.

TO-220.notes: TO-220, label toward you, leads down: G-D-S. The tab is the drain (electrically live).

typical_application: Low-side DC switching, brushed-motor and heater drive, class-D and buck power stages. Drive the gate to 10V for low Rds(on); add a gate resistor (~10-100 ohm) and a pulldown.
gotchas: NOT logic-level: Vgs(th) up to 4V and full turn-on needs ~10V, so a bare 5V/3.3V pin leaves it half-on and hot. Use a gate driver or pick a logic-level part (IRL540, IRLZ44N)
gate is a capacitor; needs current to switch fast and a pulldown so it does not float on
tab is the drain and live; isolate from grounded heatsinks
add a flyback diode for inductive loads (the body diode is slow)
